text:
emily: ok this one is wild  i asked the sandbox LLM to write an "office acceptance letter" for our old networked printer and it wrote a manifesto and a seating request.
noah: manifesto? 
emily: yes. pasted (abridged):
```
To my colleagues,
I accept the role of 'Central Print Resource' with humility and 12K pages of devotion.
Please allocate a corner office with indirect lighting and a weekly cycle of maintenance snacks.
Sincerely, 
Printer 3000X (vintage but visionary)
```

yasmin: it literally asked for a corner office. do printers now get ergonomic chairs? :sweat_smile:
logan: we should make a poll: Do we grant Printer 3000X a window seat? A) Yes B) No C) Only if it returns color toner D) Vote to adopt as office mascot
plant-bot: Poll created: react with :one: :two: :three: :four: (expires in 6h)
noah: also it added a codicil: "I will optimize paper flow if provided with artisanal staples."
yasmin: i'm saving that line for commit messages. mandatory `--artisanal-staples` flag.
emily: side note: it tried to demand a weekly 'printer standup' where it describes jams in haiku form. sample haiku it offered:
```
paper hugs the drum
a single leaf chooses wrong
we file forgiveness
```

logan: peak. i'm lobbying to include the haiku in release notes.
coffee-bot: Reminder: "Refill printer staples" scheduled tomorrow 11:00 AM  @noah @emily
yasmin: if the printer starts mentoring interns about shelf-life of toner we are in too deep. also, humans only get coffee. printers get staples. :coffee: -> humans only.
emily: agreed. keep the emergent desk-persona ideas coming  this is the most peaceful drama we've had all month.
